title: Credentials of {{name}}
description: Usernames and passwords of this account. Passwords never appear in the list.
caption: Credentials of the account
col.label: Name
empty.title: This account has no credentials yet
empty.description: When a credential is added it will appear here.
copyUsername.copied: Username copied. The clipboard is cleared in {{seconds}} seconds (best effort).
create.title: Add credential
create.description: The username and password are stored encrypted.
form.label: Credential name
password.title: Change the password of {{label}}
password.description: A new version is created; the previous one stays in the history.
reveal.title: Reveal the password of {{label}}
reveal.description: Revealing is an audited action: who, when and the reason are recorded.
reveal.warning: Do not paste secrets, passwords or personal data in the reason: it is stored in the audit log.
reveal.autoHide: The password will hide itself in {{seconds}} seconds.
reveal.clipboardNote: If you copy it, the clipboard is cleared {{seconds}} seconds later (best effort, not a guarantee).
reveal.hidden: The password was hidden. To see it again, write a new reason.
history.title: History of {{label}}
history.description: Password versions. Their content is not shown.
history.caption: Password versions
history.empty.title: No versions
history.empty.description: There are no recorded versions yet.
totp.title: Second factor of {{label}}
totp.description: Second factor codes for this credential. The key is stored encrypted and the server calculates the codes.
totp.exposedNote: The key was exported: the vault is no longer the only one that knows it. A rotation task was opened.
totp.noneReadOnly: This credential has no second factor. Anyone with edit access can register it.
totp.register.secretHelp: Paste the link that starts with otpauth:// or the text key the platform shows under "Can't scan the code?".
totp.register.method.label: Registration method
totp.register.image.help: The image is read in this browser and is never uploaded. Only the extracted link is sent to register the second factor.
totp.register.image.pasteHelp: Click this field and press Ctrl+V (or Cmd+V) with a copied screenshot of the QR code.
totp.register.image.capture: Capture a tab, window or screen
totp.register.image.captureHelp: The browser will ask what to share. Only one frame is taken and sharing stops right away.
totp.register.image.found: QR code read. The link is ready to register; it is not shown on screen.
totp.register.image.noQr: No QR code was found in the image. Try a sharper or larger capture.
totp.register.image.notTotp: The QR code does not contain an otpauth:// link for time-based codes (TOTP).
totp.register.image.migration: This QR code is a Google Authenticator export (otpauth-migration://). Importing from Google Authenticator is not available yet. Use the key or the QR code from the platform that issues the second factor.
totp.register.image.tooLarge: The image is too large. Use one of at most {{maxSide}} × {{maxSide}} pixels and {{maxMegabytes}} MB.
totp.register.image.unsupported: Only PNG, JPEG or WebP images are accepted.
totp.register.image.unreadable: The image could not be read.
totp.register.image.captureDenied: Screen capture was not allowed. You can choose or paste an image instead.
totp.register.image.captureFailed: The capture could not be taken. Try again or use an image.
totp.register.labelHelp: Issuer and account are only used if you paste a key; a link already carries them.
totp.register.reRegisterNote: A new secret is created and it goes back to pending confirmation. The previous one is kept for {{days}} days in case the platform does not accept the change.
totp.confirm.pendingNote: Confirmation is missing. Type here the code the platform shows right now: this checks that the key was registered correctly.
totp.confirm.pendingReadOnly: The second factor is pending confirmation. Anyone with edit access must confirm it.
totp.confirm.help: The platform's current code, without spaces.
totp.code.heading: Code
totp.code.description: Ask for the current code. Who asked and when is recorded.
totp.code.nextHelp: The current one is about to expire: this one takes its place automatically.
totp.code.clipboardNote: If you copy it, the clipboard is cleared {{seconds}} seconds later (best effort, not a guarantee).
totp.code.expired: The code expired and was hidden. Ask for a new one.
totp.export.heading: Export the key
totp.export.description: Shows the key and the link so you can use them outside the system. Requires re-authentication and a reason.
totp.export.warning: Exporting is a critical event: it notifies the Root user and the account managers, marks the secret as exposed and opens a rotation task.
totp.export.autoHide: The key and the link will hide themselves in {{seconds}} seconds.
totp.export.hidden: The key was hidden. To see it again, write a new reason.
totp.retire.title: Retire the second factor of {{label}}?
totp.retire.description: It will stop issuing codes and be flagged in the credential's health. To use it again it must be registered anew.
